title: Civic Notice: The Evacuation
description: A test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System. A mandatory citywide evacuation with no destination and no all-clear. Leave. Keep leaving. You may stop when the city does.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: This is a test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System. A mandatory evacuation is now in effect for all residents, all districts, all hours.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.5> Gather your household and proceed to the nearest road. Do not select a direction. The fog will select one for you.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.5> Keep moving. The route signs now read ONWARD. <p:0.3> This is correct.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.5> If you arrive somewhere you recognize, you have not yet evacuated. Continue.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: <p:0.5> This concludes the test of the Snazzie FM Civic Notification System. Thank you for evacuating.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: <p:0.5> You may stop when the city does.
